notes.title: Rocket Launch Troubleshooting Guide now available!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of Launch Director!

A [b]Rocket Launch Troubleshooting Guide[/b] is now available.

This document offers useful guidance to help you achieve a successful rocket launch!

You can view the guide on Launch Director's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2444890/Launch_Director/]Steam store page[/url] - just click "View the manual"

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lBLZPYR.png[/img]

notes.title: V3.11 Anniversary Hotfix
notes.notes:
Launch Director released on Steam one year ago today! As a birthday gift, it receives some bug fixes...

[b]In this update:[/b]
[list]
[*]Level 4 (Crewed Flight): Negative numbers should no longer be displayed as the vehicle descends if the target altitude is not met
[*]Level 4 (Crewed Flight): Added checks to prevent time dilation effects being skipped over
[/list]

notes.title: V3.10 Human Spaceflight!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of Launch Director!

In this update, the level 4 crewed flight now carries the player beyond the Karman line and into space.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JQDr2UC.png[/img]

Additionally, the capsule interior has also been reworked with added detail. Please enjoy the ride!

notes.title: 3.8 Achievements fix
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of Launch Director!

[b]In this update[/b]
[list]
[*]The game now verifies that achievements have been successfully cached and written to Steam before loading the next level/reloading the current level. If achievements are not cached and written successfully, the game re-attempts until success is reported. This should solve the issue where achievements were delayed or not attributed.
[/list]
Please report if there are any unintended consequences of this change, such as excessive loading times between levels or failure to load the next level/reload the current level.

notes.title: 3.7 New Game Intro
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of Launch Director!

[b]In this update[/b]
[list]
[*]Added realtime cutscene when starting New Game
[/list]
Enjoy a hazy sunrise helicopter flight over the city to the spaceport, and watch the rocket being transported to the pad as you land!

This cutscene is skippable - just press Enter.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XNCembn.png[/img]

notes.title: Performance update (V3.3)
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Launch Director!

This update features reworked lighting and various technical optimisations, resulting in higher frame rates. There are more performance improvements to come in the near future.
